name: Swing

parts.name: body
parts.massBasis: Hollow steel-tube A-frame swing structure ~3.4×2.2×3.1 m; mass concentrated in top bar and splayed legs, well below solid-box density. CoM slightly below geometric center due to leg mass. Variance higher than 1/12 along X/Z because mass sits near frame edges rather than filling volume.
